sentences.text: It is argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that complainant is the wife of elder brother of applicant Naresh Kumar and there was already a family settlement in respect of the property in question and respondent no. 2 got  share and she is in possession over the  share, however, she alleged that applicant encroached over her share and raised construction.

He submits that in fact,
the allegations are nothing but purely of civil nature and that is the reason, after lodging of the FIR,
respondent no. 2 filed suit bearing Civil Suit No. 86 of 2023 for mandatory injunction which is pending in the court of Civil Judge (JD), Haridwar.

4. Apart from this, he submits that on an earlier occasion, officials of HRDA stopped the applicant from raising any construction over the share of respondent no. 2 and now, the applicant is not raising any such construction over the share of respondent no. 2.
He submits that though the allegations are civil in nature despite this charge sheet has been filed in a very mechanical manner.
5. Be that as it may, whether allegations are civil in nature or not, all these aspects require deep scrutiny.

6. Mr. Akshay Latwal, learned Brief Holder for the State accepts notice on behalf of respondent no.

8. Steps be taken within a week.
9. Four weeks time is granted to the respondents to file counter affidavit.

Two weeks, thereafter, is granted to the applicants to file rejoinder affidavit.
10.

11. Till the next date of listing, further proceedings of Criminal Case No. 2614 of 2024 (State Vs.
Brahampal) pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Haridwar shall remain stayed subject to the condition that applicant will not raise any construction over the share of respondent no. 2 and will maintain peace and harmony.
